definitions.explanation: A large gathering of people in one place.

examples.japanese: {人込|ひとご}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{人込|ひとご}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人込|ひとご}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わって→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The area in front of the station was bustling with crowds.

notes:
{人込|ひとご}み refers to a dense crowd of people, typically in a busy area like a shopping street, station, or festival. It emphasizes the uncomfortable density rather than the group itself.

WRITING VARIANTS:
Can be written as {人込|ひとご}み, {人混|ひとご}み, or {人|ひと}ごみ. All are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人込|ひとご}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid crowds
- {人込|ひとご}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧: to disappear into the crowd
- {人込|ひとご}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かき{分|わ}ける→かき分ける：28182_kakiwakeru⟧: to push through a crowd
- {人込|ひとご}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the crowd
- {人込|ひとご}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: to dislike crowds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧: crowd, mob (more formal, often in news)
- ⟦{人波|ひとなみ}→人波：28183_hitonami⟧: wave of people (emphasizes flow/movement)
- ⟦{雑踏|ざっとう}→雑踏：09033_zattou⟧: throng, hustle and bustle (literary)
- ⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧: congestion, crowding (broader, includes traffic)
